dimensions.assessment: Affects healthcare professionals, paraprofessionals, and residents participating in Indian Health Service programs.
dimensions.evidence: To create a pipeline for future health care professionals, paraprofessionals, and other health-related professionals

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a new central office and interagency coordination to oversee and expand residency programs.
dimensions.evidence: establish within the Service an Office of Graduate Medical Education Programs

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes an appropriation of $4,000,000 for fiscal year 2027 and each subsequent fiscal year.
dimensions.evidence: $4,000,000 for fiscal year 2027; and $4,000,000 for each subsequent fiscal year

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Indian Health Care Improvement Act to create a new office and an interagency working group with reporting and long-term planning duties.
Permanent authorization of appropriations with a temporary interagency working group terminating after 10 years.
dimensions.evidence: The working group shall terminate on the date that is 10 years after the date of enactment of this section.

missing_information: Exact number of medical residents or facilities that will participate
importance_detail.rationale: The bill establishes an Office of Graduate Medical Education Programs within the Indian Health Service, an interagency working group, and authorizes an appropriation of not less than $4,000,000 annually starting in fiscal year 2027.
